verdict.rationale: Retell documents test surfaces: LLM Playground, simulation and batch tests, web-call testing, and draft/staging agent version tags. Its own docs state these run inside the same production workspace and API key space, with no isolated environment or separate test data store, and staging tags are 'not a separate sandbox environment.' Simulation is dry-run testing, not sandbox isolation from production data, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Conductor can run simulation tests that play out a scenario against your agent and show how it responds. This lets you check changes without making real phone calls.
Each agent starts with `prod` and `staging` tags
